auth.heroTitle: Clear student insight for teachers and school leadership.
auth.heroBody: Sign in to access protected dashboards prepared for future Canvas, report file, and student information warehouse data.
auth.error: Unable to sign in with those credentials.
dashboard.title: Student data workspace
dashboard.description: Placeholder dashboard ready for future data warehouse metrics from Canvas, report files, and student information sources.
dashboard.blankBody: The application shell, authentication flow, protected routing, and API structure are ready for the next analytics modules.
syncHistory.title: Sync history
syncHistory.description: Placeholder monitoring area for future daily data workflows. This page will later track GitHub Actions jobs that extract Canvas LMS data through the Canvas API and load the MySQL data warehouse.
syncHistory.tableHint: No ETL jobs have been built yet. These rows reserve the structure for future workflow logs, status, and run details.
syncHistory.nextStepTitle: Daily Canvas extraction via GitHub Actions
syncHistory.nextStepBody: The future workflow should authenticate to Canvas LMS with a secured API token, extract course, enrollment, assignment, submission, and activity data on a daily schedule, then write normalized records into the MySQL warehouse for dashboard reporting.
syncHistory.metrics.canvas.label: Canvas API
syncHistory.metrics.canvas.hint: Credentials and endpoints to be configured
syncHistory.metrics.schedule.label: Daily schedule
syncHistory.metrics.warehouse.label: Warehouse load
syncHistory.rows.canvas.detail: Courses, enrollments, assignments, submissions, and activity data
syncHistory.rows.reportFiles.detail: Excel-based reporting data for future ingestion

imports.title: Excel imports
imports.description: Download standardized templates for manually maintained school data, validate files before submission, and keep unverified data out of the future warehouse.
imports.templateHint: Download the approved template first. Only files with the exact standardized columns are accepted by this mock validator.
imports.fileHint: This placeholder reads Excel-compatible tabular templates generated here. It validates structure and data, then stores only mock history in your browser.
imports.awaitingUploadBody: Download the template, fill it in, then import it here to run validation before any future warehouse insert.
imports.historyTeacherHint: Teachers can only see files imported by their own account.
imports.historyAllHint: Principals and admins can see files imported by everyone.
imports.modules.behaviours.title: Student behaviours
imports.modules.behaviours.description: Quick logs for incidents, positive behaviour, classroom notes, and student support signals.
imports.modules.projects.title: Student projects
imports.modules.projects.description: Manual project tracking for subject work, interdisciplinary projects, and teacher notes.
imports.modules.parents.title: Student parents
imports.modules.parents.description: Parent and guardian contact data collected from school paperwork and teacher records.
imports.checks.templateBody: The uploaded file must use the same columns, order, and names as the selected module template.
imports.checks.studentId: Student ID must exist in the mock student registry
imports.checks.studentIdBody: Rows are rejected if student_id is missing or not found in the current mock registry.
imports.checks.requiredBody: Core columns for each module must be populated before the file can be accepted.
imports.checks.dateBody: Date-like fields are checked against the standard warehouse-friendly date format.
imports.errors.templateMismatch: Template columns do not match the selected module. Download the template and try again.
imports.errors.invalidStudentId: Row {row}: student_id '{studentId}' is not in the mock registry.
imports.errors.noRows: The file has no data rows.
